name: json-merge-patch
title: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch
prompt:
`merge_patch(target, patch)` in `patching.py` must implement RFC 7396 (JSON Merge Patch):
- if `patch` is not an object (dict), the result is `patch` itself
- otherwise the result is an object: start from `target` if it is an object, else from `{}`;
  for each key of `patch`, a `None` value removes the key, any other value is merged recursively
- arrays are replaced, never merged
- neither `target` nor `patch` may be modified (return new data)
